text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I'm wondering why Yaeno Muteki hasn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono! I am terribly sorry to have kept you waiting for so long!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The blunder of a lifetime for Yaeno Muteki...! If it has come to this, I am prepared to accept any punishment!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, a bicycle almost hit me just now,
and I attacked it purely on reflex...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the cyclist and their bike were unhurt, and we settled it as mutual carelessness, but... I completely forgot about our training in the midst of it all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki seemed to deeply regret her mistake,
so I simply told her to be more careful in the future and let the matter rest.
